objective: Show an inline error for an empty login form and clear it after valid input.

criteria.description: Submitting an empty form shows an inline error without navigation.
Entering valid fixture credentials clears the error and continues the expected login flow.
The error is readable at the target desktop and mobile viewport sizes.

checks.description: Exercise empty and valid input in the running application.
procedure: Start the application with the approved test-user fixture.
Submit an empty login form; assert an inline error and no navigation.
Enter valid fixture credentials; assert the error clears and the approved login destination opens.

checks.description: An identified human evaluates the rendered error at the agreed viewports.
procedure: Render the login error at 1280x800 and 390x844.
Confirm readable text, intact layout, and no overlap; preserve screenshots and evaluator attribution.
